nodes.name: Coprecipitation of Ni-Fe PBA
nodes.procedure: Well-dispersible Ni-Fe PBA nanocubes with a size of about 300 nm were prepared by a coprecipitation reaction.
nodes.source_text: First, well-dispersible Ni-Fe PBA nanocubes with a size of about 300 nm were prepared by a coprecipitation reaction...

nodes.name: Hydrothermal etching and nanosheet formation
nodes.procedure: 0.1 g of Ni-Fe PBA nanocubes, KMnO4 (0.474 g), and KCl (0.224 g) were dissolved in deionized (DI) water (35 mL) to form a homogeneous solution under vigorous magnetic stirring. The mixed solution was transferred to a 50 mL Teflon-lined autoclave, and then heated at 180 °C for 2 h. After cooling to room temperature naturally, the as-obtained sample (Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs) was gathered by centrifugation, cleaned with DI water and ethanol several times, then dried in a vacuum oven at 70 °C overnight.

nodes.name: Annealing of Ni-Fe-K0.23MnO2 CNFs
nodes.procedure: Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs was heated at 300 °C for 2 h to give Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 under an Ar atmosphere with a heating rate of 2 °C min^{-1}.

unit_operations.name: Annealing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs was heated at 300 °C for 2 h to give Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 under an Ar atmosphere with a heating rate of 2 °C min^{-1}.

nodes.source_text: Finally, Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs was heated at 300 °C for 2 h to give Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 under an Ar atmosphere...

nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of K0.23MnO2 NS (with annealing)
nodes.procedure: K_{0.23}MnO_2 NS was procured by the same hydrothermal process as Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 (180°C for 2h hydrothermal + 300°C for 2h Ar annealing) except for the addition of Ni-Fe PBA.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of K_{0.23}MnO_2 NS: K_{0.23}MnO_2 NS was procured by the same hydrothermal process and low-temperature annealing as Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 except for the addition of Ni-Fe PBA.

nodes.source_text: The OER performances ... were estimated by a standard three-electrode system in 1.0 M KOH solution (pH = 13.9) ... loading amount of catalysts was controlled to be approximately 2.0 mg cm^{-2} ... Chronopotentiometric tests were conducted at 10 or 50 mA cm^{-2} for 24 h ... all results in this work were corrected by iR-compensation

nodes.description: Overall water splitting in 1.0 M KOH (two-electrode)
nodes.source_text: Ni-Fe K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 electrodes were used as both the anode and cathode toward overall water splitting at a two-electrode system in 1.0 M KOH solution. ... the Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300||Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 cell showed a cell voltage of 1.62 and 1.81 V at 10 and 100 mA cm^{-2} respectively. ... the cell voltage of the Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 electrode remained almost steady at 10 mA cm^{-2} over 24 h

The C_dl of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 was calculated to be 122.8 mF cm^{-2}, larger than that of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs (96.1 mF cm^{-2}), K_{0.23}MnO_2 NS (61.6 mF cm^{-2}) ... the corresponding ECSA values are reckoned to be 3070.0, 2402.5, 1540.0

The number of active sites was reckoned by CV tests in 1.0 M phosphate buffer solution (pH = 7.0) for OER ... the TOF value of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 at 1.53 V was 0.34 s^{-1} ... up to 2.13 s^{-1} at 1.56 V
Figure 6c shows the TOF values of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 at -0.1 V and 0.2 V which were 0.42 and 1.57 H₂ s^{-1} respectively for HER

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300, Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs, and K_{0.23}MnO_2 NS all assigned to layered Birnessite-type δ-MnO₂ with poor crystallinity and no impurity peaks; Ni-Fe doped samples show peaks slightly shifted to lower angles indicating lattice expansion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD analysis (Figure 1a) showed that they can all be assigned to layered Birnessite-type δ-MnO₂ ... no distinguishable impurity peaks were detected though the crystallinity of all was poor.

nodes.characterization_summary: FESEM shows Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 as cubic nanoflowers ~700 nm side length assembled from twisted 10 nm thick nanosheets with plentiful pores.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As displayed in Figure 1b,c, for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300, a single cubic nanoflower of about 700 nm in side length was assembled from many twisted nanosheets with a thickness of about 10 nm, while containing plentiful pores among the nanosheets.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms cubic nanoflower-like morphology of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 with no core-shell structures observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The TEM image (Figure 1d) further affirmed the cubic nanoflower-like morphology of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows interplanar spacings of 0.713-0.715 nm for (001) plane and 0.248 nm for (-111) plane in Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300, larger than K_{0.23}MnO_2 NS (0.703 nm and 0.241 nm); reveals distortions, dislocations, small holes from oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1e shows that the interplanar spacing (0.713, 0.715 nm) of the clear lattice fringes of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 was assigned to the (001) plane ... many distortions, dislocations, and small holes induced by oxygen vacancies existed.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS elemental mapping shows homogeneous distribution of Mn, Ni, Fe, O, K in Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Elemental mapping images examined by energy dispersive X-ray (EDX) spectroscopy ... demonstrated the homogeneous distribution of the Mn, Ni, Fe, O, and K elements.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS confirms atomic ratio of Ni:Fe:Mn:K ≈ 3:1:28:6 for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The quantitative elemental analysis revealed that the atomic ratio of Ni, Fe, Mn, and K was around 3:1:28:6 for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 ... close to the ratio detected by inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) analysis.

nodes.characterization_summary: BET surface areas are 96 m²/g for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300, 110 m²/g for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs, and 83 m²/g for K_{0.23}MnO_2 NS; mainly mesopores 3-20 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Additionally, the Brunauer-Emmett-Teller (BET) surface areas were 96 and 110 m² g⁻¹ for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 and Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs respectively, larger than that of K_{0.23}MnO_2 NS (83 m² g⁻¹).

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS Mn 2p shows ΔE_b=11.85 eV and Mn³⁺/Mn⁴⁺ ratio 0.57:1 for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO₂ CNFs-300 (vs 0.34:1 CNFs, 0.38:1 NS); Ni 2p, Fe 2p match oxides; O 1s shows increased -OH intensity and negative shift of main peak.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As proved in the Mn 2p spectrum (Figure 2a), the peak separation energies (ΔE_b) of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO₂ CNFs-300 (11.85 eV) ... The calculated molar ratio of Mn³⁺/Mn⁴⁺ in Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO₂ CNFs-300 was approximately 0.57:1 ... The increased -OH peak intensity in Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO₂ CNFs-300 was related to the formation and increase of active (oxy)hydroxides and oxygen vacancies.

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman shows no carbon peaks confirming complete PBA decomposition; Mn-O vibration at 633 cm⁻¹ for K_{0.23}MnO_2 NS shifts to lower wavenumber for Ni-Fe doped samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman spectra (Figure 2f) exhibited the inexistence of distinguishable vibration peaks of carbon ... the Mn-O vibration peaks obviously moved to a lower wavenumber for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs and Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300.

nodes.characterization_summary: Mn K-edge XANES shows absorption edge shift to lower energy for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 indicating decreased AOS of Mn.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As exhibited in the Mn K-edge XANES spectra (Figure 3a), the main absorption edge of these catalysts gradually shifted to lower energy, indicating the decreasing AOS of Mn.

nodes.characterization_summary: Mn K-edge EXAFS shows lower peak intensity and coordination numbers (Mn-O: 4.1±0.5, Mn-Mn: 5.0±1.3) for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 confirming increased oxygen vacancies.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In R-space spectra, two distinct peaks located at about 1.47 and 2.44 Å were assigned to Mn-O and Mn-Mn shells ... The above findings strongly proved the presence and increase of oxygen vacancies.

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM-EELS shows reduced Mn AOS and increased oxygen vacancies in Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 via Mn L_{2,3}-edge shifts and O prepeak depression.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in STEM-EELS spectra (Figure 3d), compared with Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs and K_{0.23}MnO_2 NS, the reduced AOS of Mn and increased oxygen vacancies of NiFe-K_{0.23}MnO_2 CNFs-300 were revealed.

nodes.characterization_summary: Non-Faradaic CV at varying scan rates gives C_dl=122.8 mF/cm² for Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO₂ CNFs-300 (vs 96.1 CNFs, 61.6 NS), corresponding to ECSA=3070 cm².
nodes.evidence_snippet: The C_dl of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO₂ CNFs-300 was calculated to be 122.8 mF cm⁻², larger than that of Ni-Fe-K_{0.23}MnO₂ CNFs (96.1 mF cm⁻²), K_{0.23}MnO₂ NS (61.6 mF cm⁻²) ... the corresponding ECSA values are reckoned to be 3070.0, 2402.5, 1540.0 cm².
